meta.title: Cyclic colourings and polar space groups
meta.construction: Embed (M, v, τ) as (diag(M, 1), (v, τ)); cyclic phase becomes fractional height along the new z coordinate.
meta.scope_caveat: This 68-record forward regular-cyclic subset corresponds exactly to the 68 polar three-dimensional space-group types. General coloured wallpaper groups are broader, and there is no one-to-one correspondence between all coloured wallpaper groups and all 230 space groups.
meta.image_note: Space-group plate hues repeat the cyclic phase palette only to trace the height lift; colour is not additional crystallographic structure in the 3D group.
meta.external_reference: Jeremy K. Cockcroft, A Hypertext Book of Crystallographic Space Group Diagrams and Tables, UCL/Birkbeck College, 1997-1999.
meta.external_reference_cache_policy: The project does not redistribute UCL pages or images because their published end-user licence prohibits Internet distribution; hover cards reuse locally generated project plates.
